content: Josẹph osi ẹjaakhi cha for sẹ ọnang votte

Mada Josẹph oni for sẹ dọk ọfha ọbọkha k'itzitzikha s'atzọhmnọng pẹ, ọhọbhi ẹmọng obhom, “Ọnọng kpenamkpen obina k'itzitzikha saam!” Mẹ wọ, wa okkekkeminọng ọdọdọk kw'owobh mẹ kode, k'ogbe Josẹph osi ẹjaakhi cha for sẹ ọnang votte pẹ.
Wa Josẹph on-obhom ẹmọng k'ẹrọng maa anọng p'Ijip abhaanga, maa ẹhọhmmọr cha Phero ebire ẹbhaanga ẹmọng ch'obhomi.
Josẹph oben votte pẹ bi, “Kaam wọ nde Josẹph e! Otte kwaam otzim orukhi akpen kẹ o?” Yina, wa votte kẹ ebhina kafha anang, okhuri opoma-dem f'ọbọk bẹ k'itzitzikha sẹ.
Josẹph oben votte bi, “Bọng nọkhi baang-m ka for.” Mada bẹ akk'mando asa, on-oben bi, “Kaam wọ nde Josẹph, ọgbaanọtte kwabọng, kw'iwa bọng akpe anang aphyaphya p'Ijip.
Nttem nningi bọng atzim iyakhi. Bọng ayok kabira apyima bi, bọng akpe-m anang ma, okhuri bi, Ibinọkpaabyi ochi eden ọtzọhm kaam ma bi, ifha orenga ka nnam saam ọkkaana akpen p'anọng.
Onode cho afa ma p'okwo f'ideden owobh m'irek nna e, ka cho azen p'am-akwu k'itzitzikha anọng bẹ ekpo káyaabha, bẹ kabira apha.
Yina, wa Ibinọkpaabyi ochi eden ọtzọhm kaam ma bi, nkkaana nhok bọng ayok bani akpen m'ọyagbin, ifha mbiri nnang bọng ẹnaanga ch'ideden.
“Mẹ wọ, bọbọng arang asi, Ibinọkpaabyi wọ iwa ọtzọhm-m ma e. Osi-m bi, nde ọvaar kw'ajukwa pa Phero biphyir, ọmaana itta kw'ọhọhm kwẹ, ttara ọdabhi kw'anọng p'Ijip makhọra.

M'ẹbhar-ẹbhar, bọng kpa nnam k'otte kwaam atza agbaakh-ẹ bi, ‘Nnwa kwọ Josẹph ọtzọhmi ẹkkaabha ochen-ọ bi, Ibinọkpaabyi ọkk'aam ẹvaar ch'Ijip biphyir ọnanga. Kọ ogbe kàkhibhi, jekha akwu akhebh-m ka da nwobh.
Kọ otte kwaam, ọmaana va pọ, ọmaana va pa va pọ, ọmaana etzirakpo pyọ, ọmaana abhaam pọ, ttara ọttọhk kpenamkpen fọ biphyir, an-aruk k'okhubha kwa Goshẹn, ifha moruk ọbaanga ayok.
Ka Goshẹn wọ kwa kaam nkker-ọ, okhuri bi, cho azen p'okwo f'ideden awobh k'itzitzikha. Oni mando ode, kọ ọmaana ẹhọhmmọr chọ, ọmaana etzirakpo pyọ biphyir, bọng awobha k'ogbor.’
“Bọng biphyir akk'ara, ọgbaanọkka kwaam Bẹnjamin obiro ore bi, k'odik-ọkka kaam wọ mimgbaak bọng atzim ma e.
Bọng gbaak otte kwaam abarada pa kaam ngaam k'Ijip, bọng biri gbaakh-ẹ odik kpenamkpen kwa bọng akk'ara. M'ẹbhar-ẹbhar, bọng nọhng atza atzima otte kwaam akwu.”
Mẹ wọ, Josẹph ọkhaara ọgbaanọkka Bẹnjamin mbọhk, bẹ abaakha ayok, abira abhom.
Wa Josẹph obhom ẹmọng nduma otzima ọbaakha votte pẹ biphyir. Mada okk'mando ọsa, mẹ wọ kwa votte pẹ an-akhaam ottembara bi, bẹ agbaak atzim ttar-ẹ.
Mada ẹgọmi nda epyiri k'ọvaar-dimpa kwa Phero bi, votte pa Josẹph akk'akwa m'Ijip, wa ettem ẹdaam Phero ọmaana akhaan-nọng pẹ biphyir.
Phero oben Josẹph bi, “Ben votte pọ bi, ‘Odik kwa bọng asi ode bi, bọng dọkha ekpo pyabọng anana etzirakpo pyabọng, ifha bọng abhana k'ẹkhọma cha Kenaan,
bọng biri tzima atte kwabọng, ọmaana nhọhmmọr sabọng akwu k'Ijip. Kaam ńnang bọng okhubha kw'irerek s'ijibhi ọtzam, ifha bọng akhaama ekpo k'ọhaabh py'efona mẹ.’
“Kọ biri gbaak bẹ bi, ‘Odik kwa bọng asi ode bi: Bọng dọkha akpaar p'ideden pa nnyanyaang mmindọr m'Ijip, atzima atza atzọkha va pabọng, ọmaana panọng pabọng, ttara atte kwabọng atzima akwu.
Bọng ẹkhakhaama chabọng kare mach'odik kw'ọyak bọng atzim, okhuri bi, okhubha kw'irerek s'ijibhi ọtzam k'Ijip, ọkhaam bọbọng.’ ”
Mẹ wọ, wa va pa Jekọb asi odik kpenamkpen kwa bẹ atzọni bẹ. Josẹph ọnang votte pẹ akpaar p'ẹbhar p'ideden otzor k'ẹfa ch'ọvaar Phero ọkk'ọnanga, obiro ọnang bẹ ọchattọhk fa bẹ achi k'eden.
Ọnang ọnọng-ọnọng ọbara ọbhapfẹ, oyongi Bẹnjamin kw'ọnangi ashẹkẹl arọbh chi pa silva ọmaana ọbara adem azen ọdọdọk.
Wa Josẹph ọtzọkha anyanyaang-dim jobh p'atzọhk ekpo ẹkkakka py'Ijip, ọmaana anyanyaang-papẹ jobh p'atzọhk abọkpa ttara brẹd, ttara ọchattọhk ọdọdọk f'otte otzima orenga k'eden.
Mẹ wọ, mada okk'bẹ ekpo mbya okkema biphyir, oben bẹ arọhng. Mada bẹ an-abina orenga, oben bẹ bi, “Bọng ẹkhọhr k'eden kasi o!”
Mẹ wọ, bẹ abina k'Ijip akwu akhebha otte kwabẹ Jekọb k'ẹkhọma cha Kenaan.
Mada bẹ akwu apyiri, bẹ agbaak otte bi, “Josẹph otzim orukhi akpen kẹ e! Kẹ wọ ode ọvaarnọng kw'irek s'Ijip biphyir.” Jekọb okkon-ẹ, odik nwa k'odik-ọkka kọtzọk.

Yina, mada bẹ an-agbaakh-ẹ odik kpenamkpen kwa Josẹph okk'bẹ ọgbaakha, obiro ore akpaar p'ideden pa nnyanyaang mmindọr pa Josẹph ọkk'ọtzọhma bi, bẹ atzima akwu atzin-ẹ atzima achina k'Ijip, ẹfa ebire ewobha Jekọb.
Mẹ wọ, Jekọb oben bi, “Kwẹ ode odik ọkkakka e, nnwa kwaam Josẹph otzim orukhi akpen kẹ e. Kaam ngaam bi, ńda k'Ijip nda nnẹ-ẹ yina kaam ḿpe e.”
